customers.evidence: We are a fiduciary to our clients. Our clients’ interests come first.

employees.evidence: We are equally invested in the success of our firm and our colleagues.

dei.evidence: A diverse workforce is indispensable to our creativity and success.

environment.evidence: we run our business sustainably and responsibly

community.evidence: We rely on our principles to guide how we interact with each other, our clients, the communities in which we operate

integrity.evidence: We hold ourselves and each other to the highest standards of excellence.

innovation.evidence: innovation has been at the center of how we deliver performance and stay ahead of our clients’ needs.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice with a client-first framing: fiduciary and client-interest language leads. Commitments are mostly absolute ('come first', 'We are a fiduciary'), while aspirations are hedged ('We always strive', 'aspirations'). Innovation and performance dominate the bullets; sustainability and DEI appear as secondary lines.
